user.title: Connect to opencodex
user.description:
On the machine running opencodex, expose it to your network and get a key:

`ocx host enable --new-key --yes`

Then enter that machine's address and the key it printed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach opencodex at that address. Is the proxy running, and has `ocx host enable` been run on it?
error.not_opencodex: Something answered, but it is not opencodex — check the port.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Generate one with `ocx host enable --new-key --yes` or `ocx access key create`.
